rows: Explanation = deduction from laws + initial conditions; explanandum follows logically from explanans
Shadow length DN-"explains" pole height, but direction is wrong: DN has no asymmetry
Lewis: C causes E iff if C had not occurred, E would not have occurred (nearest possible world)
Woodward: C causes E iff ideal intervention on C changes E; connects causation to manipulation
Pearl: do(X=x) models intervention — sets X by cutting all arrows into X in the causal graph
A set Z that blocks all non-causal paths from X to Y, enabling observational identification of causal effect
Same functional state can have multiple physical implementations; grounds mental-level causation
